title: JARVIS energy map (jarvis-energy/1)
description: The energy plugin's site mapping file (plugins.energy.map): a hierarchy of meters (feed → panel → circuit → device) with their power and energy entities, and what each one feeds in the model. docs/plugins/energy.md explains it.

idle.description: W at or below which a meter is idle (blue). Default 5.

max.description: W that gets the full red. Default 5000.

entity.description: An entity id in the store: sensor.kitchen_power.

entities.description: One entity, or several summed (the two legs of a 240 V circuit).

feed.description: One thing in the model a meter feeds. Exactly one of registry, plate, fixture, node, room.

plate.description: A wall plate's box id: plates:<box>.

fixture.description: A light fixture id in the model.

node.description: A node name in the model.

room.description: A room id (its Floor_ node's room).

id.description: Unique in the file: energy:<id> is its subject.

kind.description: load (default) is summed into the house's load; a source (PV) or storage (a battery) is signed and shown apart.

power.description: Power (W or kW, from the entity's unit). Several are summed. Without it, the meter's power is its children's sum.

remainder.description: A sensor that reports this meter's unmetered remainder (a monitor's Balance): used for Other instead of the computed one.

panel.description: The panel it's on, as people say it: Panel A.

feeds.description: What it feeds in the model: the first one is where the meter is (flown to, drawn).

conf.description: high, medium or low: how sure the mapping is.

question.description: An open question about this meter (shown with it).

children.description: Meters downstream of this one; the remainder is shown as Other.
